Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. To get Velterra into our vendor registry and enable POs, finance only needs a minimal vendor-master payload from you. If you can send the items below we should be able to finish setup within 3 business days.

Required information (quick list):
- Legal entity name (exact as registered)
- Tax ID / TIN (or country equivalent)
- Registered address (street, city, country, postal)
- Invoice remit address (if different)
- Primary AP contact name and email
- Billing email for PO/invoice sending (we prefer invoice@velterra.io)
- Bank contact or bank letter for ACH wiring (you can send a redacted bank letter)

Attached is our vendor onboarding form (vendor_onboarding_form.pdf) — please fill the form if that's easiest. For bank details we accept a bank letter or an ACH contact email; if you'd rather us send a secure upload link say the word and I'll trigger it.

A couple of optional asks for compliance (not blocking):
- UBO / beneficial owner declaration (short form is fine)
- W-9 or local tax equivalent (if available)

Can you confirm you can provide the required fields today or tomorrow? If so I'll assign a temporary vendor ID and start the portal invite.

Best,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
